Our analysis

Of the 18 estates in our comparison, the Volkswagen Passat 1.5 eTSI is the 7th most expensive to own.

Its biggest cost is depreciation: €24,388 over 5 years, 62% of the total.

At a real consumption of 6.2 L/100 km, every 100 km costs about €11.13 in fuel.

FAQ

How much does a Volkswagen Passat 1.5 eTSI cost per month?

About €657 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €0.526 per km.

Which DGT label does the Volkswagen Passat 1.5 eTSI have?

The ECO label.
